package.name: nros_platform_nuttx
package.description:
NuttX platform support for nano-ros.
phase-349 W1: this file exists so the platform is DISCOVERABLE — the `nano_ros_provides` export below is what a source-time scan reads. What the platform declares (capabilities, arch profiles, build blocks) lives in the sibling `nros-platform.toml` (RFC-0049), read only when this platform is the one selected.
issue 1220: "sibling" became literally true here. phase-400 W1 moved the descriptor beside this package and left the announcement in the `config/` directory it came from, where it sat alone for ten days while `ProviderPackage::descriptor_path` resolved to a file that was not there. This file moved to join it.
